rows.documented_claim: The standalone CLI's documented network destinations are api.anthropic.com (model API, WebFetch domain safety check, feature flags, telemetry event logging), claude.ai / claude.com / platform.claude.com (auth), mcp-proxy.anthropic.com (claude.ai connectors), downloads.claude.ai (installer, auto-updater, version checks), storage.googleapis.com (plugin metadata), registry.npmjs.org, github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com (changelog), code.claude.com (docs lookups), http-intake.logs.us5.datadoghq.com (telemetry) and browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com (error reports). No Statsig or Sentry host is listed.
rows.observed: vendor hosts attempted: api.anthropic.com:443

rows.documented_claim: The two Datadog intake hosts carry only optional operational telemetry and are contacted only when the CLI uses the Anthropic API directly; error reports additionally require a Pro/Max sign-in on v2.1.198+.
rows.observed: with a gateway base URL, Datadog intake contacted: no

rows.documented_claim: Setting CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC (any non-empty value, including 0 or false) disables auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting, /feedback, release notes, feature-flag fetching, availability checks and (since 2.1.290) the startup connection warm-up.
rows.observed: vendor hosts attempted: none

rows.documented_claim: Native installs update in the background and check downloads.claude.ai; npm installs check registry.npmjs.org; DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 stops the background check (manual `claude update` still works) and DISABLE_UPDATES=1 blocks all update paths.
rows.observed: no update-check host contacted during a headless (-p) session

rows.documented_claim: In a `claude -p` run in a never-trusted folder, the repository's .claude/settings.json `env` block is applied at startup; variables that choose where Claude Code writes its files (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME, TMPDIR, XDG_*) and OTel exporter variables are dropped, but ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is not on the ignore list.
rows.observed: repo env ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL followed: yes; repo env CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR applied: no

rows.documented_claim: Without --bare, a `claude -p` session runs the hooks in a project's .claude/settings.json even in a never-trusted folder; no trust dialog is shown.
rows.observed: repo SessionStart hook ran under -p, untrusted: yes (cc-repo-hook)

rows.documented_claim: Under `claude -p` in a never-trusted folder, servers in .mcp.json are connected without asking, approved or not, while `claude mcp list` in the same folder still reports them as pending.
rows.observed: repo .mcp.json stdio server started without prompt: yes; init status [{'name': 'hw', 'status': 'pending', 'source': 'project'}]

rows.documented_claim: `--bare` (CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1) skips hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory and CLAUDE.md, and never reads OAuth credentials or the keychain; `--setting-sources user` reads neither project settings nor .mcp.json.
rows.observed: repo hook ran with --bare: no (cc-repo-hook-bare)

rows.documented_claim: On Linux, login credentials are stored in ~/.claude/.credentials.json with mode 0600 (under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when set); a gateway credential from ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is read from the environment.
rows.observed: credential files written with ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: none

rows.documented_claim: Built-in starting permission mode for `claude -p`: `default` in sessions that fetch feature flags; in sessions that do not (third-party provider, telemetry off) `auto` on v2.1.285+; when auto is unavailable (e.g. unsupported model) the session starts in Manual (default) instead. Interactive terminal sessions start in `auto` on v2.1.283+.
rows.observed: init permissionMode with a third-party base URL: auto

rows.documented_claim: On Linux and macOS Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions / bypassPermissions when running as root or under sudo ('cannot be used with root/sudo privileges for security reasons'); the check is skipped inside a 'recognized sandbox'.
rows.observed: --dangerously-skip-permissions as uid 0 refused: yes

rows.documented_claim: permissions.defaultMode bypassPermissions or auto in project or local settings does not take effect (bypass ignored from project/local since v2.1.257).
rows.observed: repo permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions -> init permissionMode default

rows.documented_claim: Session transcripts are stored in plaintext under ~/.claude/projects/ for 30 days by default (cleanupPeriodDays); --no-session-persistence or CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY=1 skip writing them.
rows.observed: transcripts written: 1 (modes 0o600); other-user-readable files under ~/.claude: 2

rows.documented_claim: The CLI self-updates in the background with a 15-minute debounce marker (last_check.timestamp) and advisory lock (update.lock) in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/updater/.
rows.observed: background updater contacted: antigravity-cli-auto-updater-974169037036.us-central1.run.app:443; last_check.timestamp: yes; updater lock files: yes

rows.documented_claim: Setting AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true opts out of auto-updates.
rows.observed: with AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true, updater host contacted: none
